subsections.label: (b)
subsections.plainText: (b) a wall or barrier or uniformly painted fence or fire-resistant material, at least six feet but not more than eight feet above finished grade. Such wall, barrier or fence may be opaque or perforated, provided that not more than 50 percent of the face is open.
(1) shall be maintained in good condition at all times;
